referenceSource.rootScalar: Horizons body-center range-rate relative to the Sun body center

rootResolution.coarseSchedule: uniform body-specific step over the complete half-open domain, with one guard step before the inclusive start and the stop endpoint included only to bracket boundary roots; reported roots remain inside the half-open domain
requirements: one directed range-rate crossing in each refinement bracket
strictly monotonic cubic through the crossing
pericenter or apocenter kind unchanged across coarse, medium, cubic and quadratic roots
fine cubic-versus-quadratic difference no greater than one second
rootResolution.failureDisposition: retain the candidate, samples and reason as an inconclusive root; do not pair it as a resolved reference

orbitScaleDiagnostic.clusterRule: group adjacent resolved raw roots when their separation is less than one eighth of the body's recorded mean orbit
orbitScaleDiagnostic.singletonRule: a singleton is an orbit-scale candidate
orbitScaleDiagnostic.oddAlternatingClusterRule: when an odd alternating cluster begins and ends with the same kind, select the lowest-distance pericenter or highest-distance apocenter of that repeated kind as the orbit-scale candidate and retain every other root as an additional local extremum
orbitScaleDiagnostic.ambiguousClusterRule: retain every even, nonalternating, boundary-clipped or otherwise unresolved cluster as inconclusive; select no event from it
orbitScaleDiagnostic.scope: task-scoped event-identity diagnostic, not a production definition or smoothing operation

publicPairing.rule: pair chronologically only when one unused resolved orbit-scale reference of the same kind lies within one eighth of the recorded mean orbit; zero candidates is unmatched and multiple candidates is ambiguous
publicPairing.countKindOrder: compare the complete public sequence with the resolved orbit-scale reference sequence and retain all count, kind and order failures separately from timing
publicPairing.distanceComparison: use the unchanged body-specific relative limits from approved-accuracy-targets.json as a separate diagnostic

requiredReportFields: all medium and fine root samples
limitations: finite ephemeris comparison does not establish continuous physical accuracy
Horizons numerical ephemeris and interpolation uncertainty is not a certified physical covariance
the orbit-scale grouping is an experimental event-identity diagnostic rather than a production rule
the comparison does not qualify apparent geocentric events, UTC conversion, release behavior or performance
additional local extrema are retained rather than erased or smoothed
